Design decision from Jack Heart (2026-11-22) on Fork #5 (local single-dev lifecycle / live links):

"5) i think live link probably most important if you have configured a live server, not required to support live linkns without your own live server [or, eventually using ours]"

Key implications:
- Do not auto-start a background daemon on laptops just to produce live links.
- Live links belong when a live server is configured/running (local server, team server, or eventually a hosted Etude server); not required when no live server is configured.
